mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (id, user_id, store_id, rating, content) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{foodId}, #{rating}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.user_id, v.store_id, v.rating, v.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.blinded_at FROM review v JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id WHERE v.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE review v JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id SET v.rating = #{rating}, v.content = #{content}, r.updated_at = NOW() WHERE v.id = #{id}
